d: This is an exciting opportunity for Graduate Mechanical Engineer who applies mechanical engineering principles to support the design, development, construction, operation, and maintenance of mechanical systems under the guidance of senior engineers for high profile clients.
Designing the future. Transforming the world

Wood's Oil, Gas & New Energies business is built on a strong legacy of delivering large and complex projects for national and international energy companies across the globe. We have experienced teams, a proven delivery model and a strong reputation.

We are the market-leading provider of integrated and innovative solutions that challenge the status-quo in the oil and gas upstream and midstream, onshore and offshore, gas to liquids and decarbonization and electrification markets. We pride ourselves in steady and predictable delivery, setting our sights on an exciting growth trajectory.

Energy security, transition and supply have never been more important. You, our enabling teams, are at the very forefront of transformative projects that are providing sustainable power to generations to come. We are the ones to bring low-carbon concepts to reality.
Meaningful and interesting projects: Delivered to high profile clients across the Energy Sector

Motivated and detail-oriented Mechanical Engineering graduate seeking an entry-level position to apply technical knowledge, analytical skills, and engineering principles in designing, maintaining, and improving mechanical systems while contributing to organizational growth and developing professional expertise.
q: Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering from a recognized university.
Fresh graduate or up to 2 years of relevant experience.
Basic understanding of mechanical engineering principles, thermodynamics, fluid mechanics, and machine design.
Knowledge of engineering standards, codes, and safety regulations.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
Familiarity with engineering software such as AutoCAD, SolidWorks, CATIA, ANSYS, or similar tools.
Good written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to work effectively in a team environment.
Attention to detail and commitment to quality.
r: li
Assist senior engineers in the design and development of mechanical systems and equipment.
li
Prepare engineering calculations, technical reports, drawings, and documentation.
li
Support the review of design drawings, specifications, and vendor submissions.
li
Participate in equipment selection, material selection, and engineering evaluations.
li
Conduct site inspections and monitor installation activities to ensure compliance with project requirements.
li
Assist in troubleshooting mechanical equipment and resolving technical issues.
li
Support construction, testing, commissioning, and start-up activities.
li
Ensure adherence to safety, quality, and environmental standards.
li
Coordinate with multidisciplinary teams, contractors, and suppliers.
li
Monitor project progress and assist in preparing status reports.
li
Maintain engineering records, databases, and document control systems.
li
Participate in risk assessments and quality assurance activities.
li
Learn and apply relevant engineering codes, standards, and industry best practices.
li
Utilize engineering software such as AutoCAD, SolidWorks, Revit, or ANSYS for design and analysis.
li
Continuously develop technical knowledge and professional competencies through training and project involvement.
